Name: Crops grow in one day
Author: nastapolka
Description:
[size=5][b][u]How to use
[/u][/b][/size][size=4] ﻿1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url]and this mod.
﻿2. Crops, fruit trees, and casks go zoom zoom.[/size][size=4]
[b][u]
[/u][/b][/size][size=5][b][u]What it does[/u][/b][/size][size=4]
﻿- Makes crops grow in 1 day. (Still needs to be watered, though).
﻿- If it's a crop that can be harvested multiple times, it regrows in 1 day.
﻿- Fruit trees grow 1 stage per day (if usual requirements are met, i.e. nothing in the 8 tiles around it).
﻿- Cask contents increase in quality by 1 tier per day.

[/size][size=5][b][u]Settings[/u][/b][/size][size=4]
﻿If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is also installed, you can toggle the mod's features (all are on by default):
﻿- Crop growth speed
﻿- Fruit tree growth speed
﻿- Cask speed
﻿You'll need to [u]restart the game[/u] for any changes to take effect.
[/size][size=5]
[b][u]Caveat[/u][/b][/size][size=4]
If there's another mod installed that modifies fruit tree and cask speed, things may break.


[/size]

Downloads.Description: Fixed crops not growing quickly when certain other mods are installed.
